why_that_measure: 1k's own sentence: max_seed_only_effect is 'the same functional at the null point'. The proxy is that functional where the two families coincide; the named test is that functional where they do not. A232_premise_stated.holds_if: clearing dispersion across seeds does not exceed seed-only max excursion, i.e. no seed-by-family interaction exceeding seed-alone variation
A232_premise_stated.correction_to_my_own_prior_wording: I wrote twice, and the declarer wrote in A221, that a maximum over a set is not below a dispersion over that set. That is true for the SAME set under the SAME functional. Proxy and test are not: the proxy is the functional at the NULL point (seed noise alone, families coincident); the test is the functional at the ACTUAL point and contains the seed noise AND whatever the real family difference does across seeds. If the family difference interacts with seed — some seeds separating the families more than others — the clearing's dispersion can EXCEED the seed-only maximum. Grain placement, tile phase and lobe sampling are all seed-dependent and nothing in the rig forbids it. The claim is empirical
A232_premise_stated.consequence_if_it_fails_A235: the declaration's sentence 'this can only move adequacy toward MET — the direction that favours me' is TRUE ONLY UNDER THIS PREMISE. If the premise fails, adequacy can move toward UNMET and things currently banked can come back. The A222 fence was built against a loosening move; it turns out to fence a move whose direction is not known in advance — a stronger reason for the fence, not a weaker one
